intent.note: Does the diff do what the clause asked: for tools/capture-screenshots.mjs, yes. confirmWrite(page,label,write) arms page.waitForResponse (method+path) and a MutationObserver on #toast (childList/characterData only) before clicking dialog.confirm [data-cfgo]; it returns once the response arrived and a toast was written. It throws naming the save for no answer, for answered-but-no-toast, and for a page with no #toast. Nine click-then-sleep sites in the panel legs were converted (composition, moved-manifest, settings, skills x2, settings restore, proposals drop/revive/materialize). I read the remaining [data-cfgo] clicks: 3036, 3531, 4687, 5690, 5782 are Discards with no request, and 4654/4699 already wait on the PUT response plus the card paint, so leaving them is right. Toast-after-handling checked against the panel source: write-confirmation.js saveOutcome toasts on success, proposals-view.js toasts after propReload, core.js toast() writes textContent and its timer touches only className, and no toast() call in ui/panel/*.js is timer-driven. The held-answer leg (skills clear-back) routes **/api/composition, holds the PUT 2500 ms, counts holds and fails unless exactly one was held; under the old 900 ms wait the disk read would still see null and the existing 'did not write [] back' fail would fire, so the reasoning for the red direction holds; it was not run, per instructions. Existing fail/note strings are unchanged; one new note and one new fail were added, and one POLL_WAIT_ALLOWED row. The refresh-race mechanism is untouched. Divergence: the clause says 'anywhere else the same shape appears' and acceptance (1) says 'no place in the tool'; stage-tabs.mjs (imported by the tool) keeps two confirm-then-900ms-then-read policy saves (finding 1). The executor's outcome describes the diff accurately and names this gap itself, but the scope difference stands. Dependants: every leg after a confirm now starts after the answer and the toast, which is no earlier than before in any case that mattered; repro mode shares the legs with no branch; text-pinning suites were not touched by the diff (the executor ran the gate-card-wait scanner against the edit).
